fx_sensitivity: An unfavorable exchange rate movement of 10% to our portfolio of foreign currency contracts would have resulted in an increase in unrealized losses of $163 million as of December 31, 2025 and $124 million as of December 31, 2024.
interest_rate_sensitivity: A 100 basis points increase in interest rates would have had an approximate $400 million reduction on the fair value of our fixed-rate debt as of December 31, 2025 and 2024.
